decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding Thomas Archibald Roberts's spouse. Document 1 (D1S2) explicitly states he married 'Austrian politician Johannes Schwarzenberg'. Document 2 (D2S3, D2S9, D2S11) explicitly states he is married to 'Myra Elizabeth Tweedie', citing 'The Peerage' as a source. Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers when competing assertions exist without a definitive resolution mechanism in the source text, both names are included as supported candidates.
